run_gmock_doctor: pipe compiler error messages into gmock_doctor.py via stdin to get plain English diagnoses
diagnose_gmock_errors: call Diagnose with a compiler error message string to get a list of human-readable diagnoses
review_generic_diagnoser: review the _GenericDiagnoser factory function that creates pattern-matching diagnosers from regex and diagnosis pairs
review_common_gmock_symbols: review the _COMMON_GMOCK_SYMBOLS list containing matchers, actions, cardinalities, and misc Google Mock symbols
review_diagnoser_list: review the _DIAGNOSERS list of 13 specialized diagnoser functions for Google Mock error patterns
